title: Voice and Touch Commands
summary: Feedback about command features centers on voice control convenience, required phrasing, and passenger understanding of touch-based controls, with many examples being descriptive rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the voice command system for conveniently performing actions such as lowering the windows.

negative.summary: The negative review dislikes having to speak a voice command each time to close the doors.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe how voice or touch commands work, including required wording, navigation commands, and passenger confusion with rear touch controllers, without a clear sentiment.

limitations: The sample is small and many examples are undetermined, limiting confidence about overall customer sentiment.
The topic includes both voice-command behavior and touch-command usability, which are related but not identical subjects.
